mechanism: Both drugs are nephrotoxic and aminoglycosides potentiate beta-lactam nephrotoxicity through synergistic renal tubular damage and reduced glomerular filtration.
action: Monitor renal function closely (baseline and every 2-3 days); maintain adequate hydration; consider alternative aminoglycoside dosing strategies or non-aminoglycoside alternatives if possible; assess tobramycin levels if available.
